issues.title: Loan Simple leads receiving duplicate tasks in post-referral and pre-referral workflows
issues.desc: Loan Simple leads were triggering duplicate tasks across multiple workflows, including post-referral and pre-referral workflows. The issue was caused by a bugged filter related to Loan Simple lead associations in HubSpot. HubSpot support was engaged and the issue was resolved.
issues.workaround: Review any LS leads that received duplicate tasks during the impact window and manually close or delete the duplicate tasks.

issues.title: Post-referral workflow tasks continuing after deal marked as Closed Lost or Transferred
issues.desc: Deals marked as Closed Lost or Transferred were still receiving post-referral workflow check-in tasks, meaning the workflow was not properly suppressing or unenrolling contacts upon those deal stage changes. The workflow filters were tweaked to address the issue. Both Closed Lost and Transferred statuses were affected.
issues.workaround: Manually dismiss any erroneous check-in tasks that were generated for deals already marked as Closed Lost or Transferred during the impact window.

issues.title: Automated emails sending with previous loan officer info after LO change
issues.desc: When a loan officer was changed on a deal, automated emails continued to reference the previous LO rather than the newly assigned one. This affected agent-facing automated emails which displayed the wrong LO contact information. The issue was resolved by Luis on the product side.
issues.workaround: For any deals where the LO was changed during the impact window, manually send corrected emails to agents with the updated LO information.

issues.title: Offer Accepted workflow not re-triggering when deal stage reverts and returns to Offer Accepted
issues.desc: When a deal was moved to Offer Accepted, then reverted to an earlier stage, and then moved back to Offer Accepted, the workflow tasks did not re-trigger the second time. This caused closing info collection tasks to be missed for deals that had fallen out of contract and gone back under contract. The fix was adding 'deal stage = Offer Accepted' as a re-enrollment criteria in the workflow.
issues.workaround: Manually enroll any deals that went through a second Offer Accepted transition during the impact window to ensure TC tasks and closing info collection are completed.

issues.title: MRC and other deals not enrolling into TC workflow upon Offer Accepted stage
issues.desc: Deals from MRC and certain other sources were not triggering the TC workflow and tasks when updated to Offer Accepted, leaving transaction coordinators without any automated task assignments. HubSpot support identified and resolved the issue. Leads without a lender assigned appeared to be commonly affected, though the root cause was confirmed via HubSpot support.
issues.workaround: Manually enroll any deals updated to Offer Accepted between approximately February 4 and April 1 into the TC workflow to ensure closing tasks are completed.

issues.title: Post-referral workflow not triggering tasks after referral acceptance
issues.desc: A deal accepted on March 18th did not trigger any post-referral workflow tasks for the home advisor. The root cause was identified as a data-pulling error that prevented the workflow from filtering correctly. The issue was escalated to the product team for resolution.
issues.workaround: Manually review and complete any post-referral tasks for deals where the referral was accepted around March 18th and no workflow tasks were generated.

issues.title: Buyer credit SMS sent at Offer Accepted stage without credit amount populated
issues.desc: An SMS notifying the buyer of their credit amount was being sent when a deal reached the Offer Accepted stage, before closing information had been submitted and the credit amount could be calculated. The SMS should only send at the Sale Pending stage with the actual dollar amount included. This was confirmed to be a dashboard-triggered communication and was escalated to the product team.
issues.workaround: For any buyers who received the incomplete buyer credit SMS at the Offer Accepted stage, manually follow up with the correct credit amount once closing information has been submitted.
